articles.summary: Advanced semiconductor chips power next-generation technologies such as AI and quantum computing, but their performance also depends on sophisticated microelectronic packaging. This article explores advanced packaging materials and manufacturing processes designed to protect high-performance chips from heat and environmental contaminants.
articles.title: Achieving hermetic sealing in advanced microelectronic packages
